raw.rationale: CX-5461 is a selective RNA polymerase I inhibitor that causes nucleolar stress and p53 activation, with known hypersensitivity in homologous recombination-deficient and some MYC-driven or hematologic contexts, but PRISM single-agent 5-day data show little lineage-selective killing across these common solid-tumor lineages. Thus most lineages have low selective-killing probabilities near the base rate, with only modest elevations for breast/ovary (BRCA/HRD) and possibly MYC-associated lineages.
